title: Naturality of explicit open tensor-section comparisons
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion] and $F$ any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an etale object $v:V\to U$, let $d_v:\Gamma(V,(v\circ j)^*F)\to\Gamma(V,v^*(F|_U))$ be the isomorphism given by $c_{v,j}^{-1}$ followed by $v^*\lambda_F$, evaluated on global sections. Here pullback is the tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], $c$ is the unit-normalized composition comparison and $\rho$ denotes its section restrictions [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial], and $\lambda_F:j^*F\to F|_U$ is the unique left-adjoint comparison intertwining the tensor-pullback and open-restriction adjunction units [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction]. For every morphism $g:w\to v$ of etale objects over $U$, write $j_!g$ for the same triangle over $X$, obtained by composing its structure arrows with $j$. Then $\rho^F_{j_!g}\,;\,d_w=d_v\,;\,\rho^{F|_U}_g$, where semicolon denotes composition in execution order. No quasi-coherence hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Stacks Descent 03DR (section-quasi-coherent-topologies, equation-quasi-coherent-presheaf), 03DU (definition-quasi-coherent-topologies), item 4; Sites 00XZ; the sectionwise argument in the original item proof[4].

proof.text: Expand the restrictions into section units, normalized composition maps, and triangle transports. Unit naturality moves the pullback of the open-restriction comparison past the section unit. Normalized composition associativity for g.left, v.hom, j moves the inverse v,j comparison past the composition map. Naturality of the composition comparison in the module moves the remaining open-restriction comparison across it. Triangle transports coincide by g.w and scheme associativity. Evaluate the resulting module equations at the whole source scheme.

theorem etaleOpenTensorSectionsComponent_naturality {X U : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : X.Modules) {v w : U.Etale} (g : w ⟶ v) :
    Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale j)).map g) ≫
      (etaleOpenTensorSectionsComponentIso j F w).hom =
    (etaleOpenTensorSectionsComponentIso j F v).hom ≫
      Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F) g
